entries.title: Synara v1.6.5
entries.note: Better multilingual transcripts, retained OpenCode reasoning, and more predictable Antigravity resume. Added The analytics receiver can group Remote connection failures by stage, network kind, and connection path when updated iPhone and iPad clients send those categories. Desktop Beta adds six consent-gated reliability codes for admission, authorization, tunnel provisioning, and connector exits. Payloads use fixed categories without hostnames, IP addresses, network names, or free-form errors. The receiver migration and deployment are separate from this Stable desktop release. ( #2257 ) Changed Desktop refreshes the recorded app version for existing Remote links when reporting endpoints. The account service also gains maintenance logic to retire stale pre-Stable Remote 1.0.6 preview identities after a grace period. That cleanup runs through account service maintenance. ( #2256 ) Browser C

entries.title: Synara v1.6.4
entries.note: Antigravity connectors, lighter Remote reconnects, and more usable narrow chats. Added Antigravity sessions can use Synara tools and connected services such as Notion and Linear. The new ACP integration streams reasoning, tool activity, context usage, and questions, and resumes existing conversations. Requires Antigravity CLI 1.5.0 or newer. Start a new session to pick up newly connected services. ( #2233 ) New pull requests created through Synara include a “Created with Synara” link by default. Turn it off in Settings → Models & writing → Add Synara attribution . ( #2229 ) Changed Remote can catch up a cached chat using just that chat's changes, even after heavy unrelated desktop activity. entries.title: Synara v1.6.3
entries.note: Faster long chats, live tool activity, and dependency seeding for macOS worktrees. Added The chat working indicator shows the current tool call, recent failure, or a request for approval or an answer. Tool runs fold into summaries that distinguish actions such as code search and web search. ( #2220 ) On macOS, newly created worktrees can inherit eligible node_modules directories through APFS cloning when the tracked lockfiles match. Cloning is best effort and project setup scripts still run. In one Synara checkout benchmark, cloning 13 directories took 1.9–3.2 s, compared with 6.5 s for a warm Bun install in a fresh worktree. ( #2219 ) Changed Chats start loading on a sidebar press and reuse settled Markdown when transcript rows come back into view. In a headless Chromium A/B benchmark with seeded conversations, median first opens took 16–20% less time, and repeat scroll flings used 19–2

entries.title: Synara v1.6.2
entries.note: Local video playback, Codex Ultrafast and more reliable worktrees. Added Play and seek local MP4, M4V, WebM, MOV and OGV videos in file previews and inline in chat. Unsupported codecs offer download and retry; desktop-proxied remote hosts offer download instead of streaming. Choose Codex Ultrafast when the account's model catalog advertises it. Speed choices follow the selected model and account. Discover the Synara for iPhone beta from an eligible desktop launch announcement. Remove empty Remote projects from the sidebar without deleting their files; archived chats and unsent drafts prevent removal. Changed Worktree creation completes without waiting for unrelated Git and GitHub refreshes and uses parallel checkout unless configured otherwise. In one isolated 10,000-file repository run, creation completed in 1.21 seconds; no equivalent before measurement was made. Codex startup warnings

entries.title: Synara v1.6.0
entries.note: Composer suggestions, clearer tables and a lighter desktop. Added After a settled main-chat reply, a supported provider can suggest a follow-up in the empty composer. Tab inserts an editable draft; it never sends automatically. Disable it in Settings → Chat behavior → Show suggestions. Generation uses the chat's provider and recent conversation context; unsupported providers offer no suggestion. Chat tables keep short values, numbers and units together, scroll horizontally when necessary, and offer Copy table to copy their Markdown. Changed Desktop startup defers unused provider and service work, uses a version-scoped backend compile cache and stops background usage work during shutdown. In source-build tests on one Mac, three streaming Claude threads used 3,136 MB versus 2,281 MB of process-tree memory (27% less). entries.title: Synara v1.5.2
entries.note: Synara 1.5.2 Stable Linux ARM64: Download the ARM64 AppImage alongside x86_64. Each architecture has its own update feed. Usage analytics: Explore token and activity trends by provider, model and project. Costs are reported or estimated at API rates, not subscription charges. On macOS, This Mac can include local Codex and Claude Code sessions. Connected computers: Choose which computer's host-owned settings to edit and see available signed-in identity for supported Codex and Claude accounts. Reliability: Account recovery, chat sends, queued work and Remote connections handle interruptions more reliably. macOS update preparation and shutdown, simulator control, onboarding and rate-limit messages also improve.
